intuition.title: Feed mode changes elemental composition
intuition.text: Two dropwise reactions yield elemental-analysis ratios Bi1.00Te0.95 andBi1.00Te1.10, distinct from the intended Bi2Te3 composition. Their water/AOT ratios, exact feed quantities and structures are unreported. They do not inherit the microscopy or phase figures of the rapid-addition powders.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
